Calls the real API at http://localhost:5141 for the seeded "Dev Test Website". Unlike the earlier version of this page, consent starts pending here — nothing is granted automatically.

quickstart.md §2 walkthrough

  1. Load this page. Confirm the number below stays 01632 960000 (the default) and the status box shows no session — consent hasn't been answered yet.
  2. Click Grant Consent. Confirm the number changes to an allocated tracking number and the status box shows a session ID.
  3. Click Go to Page 2 →. Confirm the same number is still shown there (no second allocation) — that's session stickiness across a full page navigation (FR-010).
  4. Come back here and click Withdraw Consent. Confirm the number reverts to the default and the status box shows the session gone.
